# Digital Nomad In Spain

> Spain visa consultancy helping non-EU citizens obtain the Digital Nomad
> Visa (DNV) and Non-Lucrative Visa (NLV) and relocate legally to Spain.
> 98% approval rate, end-to-end support, 500+ approved clients.

Digital Nomad In Spain provides expert guidance, document preparation, and
application support for remote workers, freelancers, and retirees seeking
Spanish residency. We are not a law firm; we do not provide legal advice.

## Services

- [Digital Nomad Visa](https://www.digitalnomadinspain.com/services/digital-nomad-visa): requirements, income thresholds, documents, and application process for remote workers and freelancers.
- [Non-Lucrative Visa](https://www.digitalnomadinspain.com/services/non-lucrative-visa): requirements and process for retirees and passive-income earners.
- [Services overview](https://www.digitalnomadinspain.com/services): comparison of both visa pathways.
- [Eligibility Checker](https://www.digitalnomadinspain.com/eligibility): free assessment of which visa fits a given situation.
- [Book a Consultation](https://www.digitalnomadinspain.com/book): free and paid consultation booking.
